card.name: Words before comparisons of amount or level
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as are, there, at, to and twice, placed where the next words compare an amount, rate or level (as many as, at the same dose, to a greater extent).

modes.label: Equal-amount comparisons
modes.description: A verb or word just before an as-many-as or twice-the-usual comparison.
modes.example: it turns out that there<< are>> as many odd numbers as natural numbers.

modes.label: Preposition before a level or dose
modes.description: The word at or to just before a stated level, dose, rate or size.
modes.example: is maintained<< at>> satisfactory levels, the dosage schedule may be

modes.label: Twice the usual dose
modes.description: The word twice at the start of a dosing-regimen description.
modes.example: is a corticosteroid dosing regimen in which<< twice>> the usual daily dose of corticoid

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like different and same, and away from words about degree or amount such as moderately or vary.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before the text compares amounts, levels or doses.
